title: Spain's most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Spain in full internationals, from Spain's first match to the 2026 World Cup final.

notes.Gerard Pique: Gerard Pique is joint 11th with 102 caps, just outside.
notes.Raul: Raul is joint 11th with 102 caps, just outside.

sources: https://tmapi.transfermarkt.technology/player/<id>/performance-game (Transfermarkt match-by-match national team record for each player)
https://www.national-football-teams.com/country/174/2026/Spain.html (and each player page, /player/<id>/<name>.html, listing every match)
checks: Transfermarkt's Spain record list and RSSSF agree on every total in the ten and on 11th to 14th; none of these players has played since 2022, and national-football-teams.com agrees on every one too.
